notes.title: Endless RPG Toolset Now Supports D&D 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37284337/c477d9c10f64a39f55dad947db6d82bfc575f126.png[/img]

Are you jumping to the new edition?  

The Endless RPG Solo Play Toolset now allows you to choose D&D 2024 as a system.  You can also choose D&D 5e as an expansion, which brings in any creatures or items from 5e that aren't included in D&D 2024.  This includes choosing expansion books like Tasha's Cauldron of Everything or Xanathar's Guide to Everything.  

When you are ready to make the jump, simply go into Settings and choose the new system.  Remember, you cannot change your system while you have a map active.  

[b]Notes on the D&D 2024 update:[/b]

[list]
[*] Creatures who can level up in a class such as orcs, goblins, drow, etc., will follow the progression included in the 2024 Player's Handbook, including learning new spells added with the edition.
[*] While most classes stick to the 2024 ruleset, the wizard class still allows creatures to specialize in schools not available with the D&D 2024 ruleset such as Enchanter.  This has been done to ensure that fighting against evil mages has a wide variety of encounters. 
[*] The Monster Manual 2025 update did away with the humanoid category in favor of placing various humanoids in other categories such as goblins moving to fey and gnolls moving to fiends.  Endless RPG will still have these creatures under the humanoid category.  I feel this is easiest when navigating the app and picking out enemies. 
[*] Orcs are included! Don't worry, orcs aren't going anywhere in Endless RPG.  Along with Drow elves and Duergar dwarves, orcs are one of many humanoids that can be chosen as an enemy.  They can also level up in classes to present a better challenge. 
[/list]

notes.title: Endless RPG 2.14
notes.content:
* D&D 2024 support including monsters from the 2025 manual and advanced encounters that contain creatures that level up in a class. D&D 2024 treats 5e as an expansion that can be turned on and off in settings along with other 5e-supported expansions.
* New treasures from Tasha's Cauldron of Everything and Xanathar's Guide to Everything.  These can be selected in the settings.
* PC users can select using a touch screen in the settings.
* Various bug fixes

notes.title: Endless RPG 2.13a
notes.content:
* New Quick Mission system for D&D 
* New treasure distribution system for D&D to make items more consistent 
* Tieflings and Goliaths have arrived
* Hotfix for bug with new installs

notes.title: Endless RPG 2.13
notes.content:
* New Quick Mission system for D&D 
* New treasure distribution system for D&D to make items more consistent 
* Tieflings and Goliaths have arrived

notes.title: Endless RPG 2.09
notes.content:
* Duergar have grown more powerful
* Rebalanced some advanced encounters
* Fixed bug with using random monster types while using Pathfinder system
* Various other small bug fixes

notes.title: Endless RPG 2.08
notes.content:
* Skeletons have grown more powerful
* Encounter difficulty no longer accounts for more than four characters in the party, which means the base encounter difficulty for a specific CR will always be the same. This means you can use a party spot for a non-character such as a druid companion without making encounters more difficulty
* Bug fixes

notes.title: Endless RPG 2.07
notes.content:
* The Kuo-toa have grown bolder
* Monstrosities converted to new encounter system
* Maps can be exported while in DM mode
* Fixed various errors including an error choosing yuan-ti and kuo-toa for custom dungeons

notes.title: Endless RPG 2.0.6
notes.content:
* Orcs have grown stronger
* New environmental effects
* New color coding for the battlemap to help differentiate the sides

notes.title: Endless RPG 2.0.5
notes.content:
* Advanced Mercenaries have arrived in 5e
* More in-depth itemization for advanced encounters
* Bug fixes

notes.title: Endless RPG 2.0.4
notes.content:
* Added map themes that include mystic, unholy, military, and other themes.  There are 10 different map types with 40 unique combinations allowing you to create a webbed cave, unholy stronghold, mystic tower, military keep, dungeon jail, etc.
* Fixed an issue that was blocking proper error tracking

notes.title: Endless RPG 2.0.3
notes.content:
* New dungeon map that is smaller than the previous map.  There are now two dungeons, the larger of which having a (L) next to its name. 
* New tomb map. This map is similar to the crypt but smaller.

notes.title: Endless RPG 2.0.2
notes.content:
* New maps and map sizes.  You can now choose a cavern (small cave), keep (small tower), outpost (tiny map) or fortress (smaller stronghold).  
* Bandits have gained additional classes
* Fixed bug allowing the battle map to be entered when there are no party members
* Fixed bug displaying trap information when there are no party members
* Increased bug tracking and fixed a syncing issue

notes.title: Endless RPG 2.0.1
notes.content: * Ashfang Goblins have been spotted roaming the woods at night and inhabiting nearby caverns. The Ashfang Goblins are a powerful goblin tribe.
